newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-BENFICA THRASHED 5-2 IN COPA CENTENARIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA THRASHED 5-2 IN COPA CENTENARIO.

text.p: Big-spending Benfica crashed 5-2 to previously goal-shy Flamengo in the Copa Centenario on Tuesday.
The Portuguese giants had been humbled 4-1 by local team Cruzeiro in their first game on Sunday.

Although Benfica can claim the competition is merely a pre-season warm-up, the two results must be of concern to a club that has spent around $14 million in a bid to end arch-rivals Porto's grip on the Portuguese championship. Porto have won the competition for the past three years.
Cruzeiro had fielded a reserve side in Sunday's game as their first team are in Peru for the first leg of the South American Libertadores Cup final on Wednesday.
Benfica's defence proved easy meat for a Flamengo side that has lost their last three games in the Brazilian championship without scoring a goal.
Earlier, Cruzeiro's reserves scored their second triumph of the tournament when they beat Paraguayans Olimpia 1-0 with an early goal by 17-year-old Geovani, who scored twice against Benfica.
